nasdaq.name: Nasdaq
nasdaq.coverage: No exact Monid company count verified. Related official feeds cover US exchange-listed securities; each news, fund, options and filing tool can cover a different subset.
nasdaq.coverageShort: Unknown Monid count; US exchange-listed source scope, tool dependent.
nasdaq.source: Nasdaq is an official exchange operator. Its website also republishes third-party company data and journalism. These Monid listings are not verified as licensed Nasdaq feeds.
nasdaq.timing: Website quote bar: three-second refresh; indices at least one minute delayed. Short interest is twice-monthly. Neither establishes Monid delivery latency. The separate official Retail Trading Activity Tracker is daily with a one-day reporting lag.
nasdaq.quality: Strong potential traceability for exchange data and original filings; mixed confidence for estimates, third-party news and derived fields. No measured connector accuracy.
nasdaq.rights: Nasdaq website terms restrict automated capture and commercial copying, storage and derivative products without consent. A separate licensed feed/distributor agreement is the relevant route; no Monid pass-through grant established.
nasdaq.audience: Retail investors and analysts are the apparent audience. Trading 212 and Microsoft Excel are named users of the separate direct Nasdaq Last Sale product, not these Monid tools.
nasdaq.decision: Conditional research candidate; use an authorised Nasdaq route for critical prices.

yahoo-finance.name: Yahoo Finance
yahoo-finance.coverage: Global exchanges are listed in Yahoo help, but no exact company or news count was verified for Monid. Quote, profile and headline coverage are different questions.
yahoo-finance.coverageShort: Unknown Monid count; global exchange support at source.
yahoo-finance.source: Publisher and secondary financial-data aggregator. Not the original issuer of every article or price record; Monid distribution authority unverified.
yahoo-finance.timing: Exchange dependent: the official table includes real-time Nasdaq, 15-minute OPRA/OTC, 20-minute ASX and 30-minute Shanghai/Shenzhen. Monid adds unmeasured collection/cache lag.
yahoo-finance.quality: Useful international research scope, but adjustments, stale profiles, article duplicates and ticker matching need measurement. No accuracy percentage established.
yahoo-finance.rights: Yahoo Finance help prohibits redistribution of its displayed/provided information. No separate Monid grant was verified. Article and photo rights require their own entitlement.
yahoo-finance.audience: Suitable for individual investors and analysts (product assessment); no named production customer verified for these Monid endpoints.
yahoo-finance.decision: On-demand alternative only after rights resolution; comparatively costly for frequent polling.

finviz.name: Finviz
finviz.coverage: The stock-only website screener showed 5,613 ticker rows; the unrestricted version 11,614 including funds. These dynamic observations are not unique companies, insider/news coverage or Monid-supported totals. Source FAQ lists Nasdaq, NYSE and AMEX.
finviz.coverageShort: Website: 5,613 stock ticker rows observed; exact Monid/per-tool count unknown.
finviz.source: Secondary screener/aggregator. Direct Elite API/export access exists, but the Monid connector is not verified as that authorised product.
finviz.timing: Free website stock quotes are one minute delayed; Elite quotes can be real time; fundamentals refresh hourly. News/insider latency and Monid refresh remain unknown.
finviz.quality: Useful screening context, subject to universe/result caps. Sentiment is an interpretation, with no validated model or factual-accuracy score established.
finviz.rights: Direct API policy is personal-use and prohibits third-party redistribution/resale. Its one-request-per-five-seconds limit is not a verified Monid limit. A personal Elite subscription is not a licence for our app users.
finviz.audience: Finviz addresses beginners and professional traders. No named production customer verified for these Monid tools.
finviz.decision: Potential screener feature, secondary priority; resolve licence and pagination first.

marketbeat.name: MarketBeat
marketbeat.coverage: Website advertises 20,000 public-company profiles, with US, Canadian and UK sections. No exact Monid count or assurance that all 14 tools cover all these companies was verified.
marketbeat.coverageShort: Website claim: 20,000 company profiles; Monid/per-tool count unknown.
marketbeat.source: Private publisher and aggregator; discloses market-data suppliers and editorial policies. SEC-derived insider tables remain secondary.
marketbeat.timing: Source fair-market-value estimates update each minute; other Barchart market data is at least ten minutes delayed. Model scores, earnings and holdings have different cadences; Monid latency unmeasured.
marketbeat.quality: Editorial source checks and corrections are positive signals, not a measured endpoint error rate. Some summaries use AI; ratings/forecasts and MarketRank are opinions or models.
marketbeat.rights: Terms distinguish personal access, site/XML licences and commercial licensing, and restrict bulk redistribution. No Monid downstream customer-display/storage grant established.
marketbeat.audience: Retail-investor publisher with a large claimed newsletter readership. This is audience evidence, not named Monid API-customer evidence.
marketbeat.decision: One of the more relevant headline/research candidates, conditional on a valid commercial licence.

stockanalysis.name: StockAnalysis
stockanalysis.coverage: Website advertises 130,000+ tradable symbols worldwide, including ETFs and multiple listings. This is not a unique-company number or proven Monid coverage. Seven listings were retrievable although eight were advertised.
stockanalysis.coverageShort: Website claim: 130,000+ tradable symbols, not companies; Monid count unknown.
stockanalysis.source: Secondary research publisher using providers including S&P Global and Fiscal.ai. It explicitly says it has no programmatic API/MCP and lacks programmatic resale rights.
stockanalysis.timing: US website stock pages refresh every five seconds for free users and stream for paid users; source screeners are roughly minute-based; other markets can be delayed or end-of-day. This is not Monid streaming evidence.
stockanalysis.quality: Documented upstream vendors and review practices support manual research. No independent Monid accuracy or completeness benchmark; derived ratios and financial periods need reconciliation.
stockanalysis.rights: Published no-programmatic-access position is a concrete blocker for assuming these are official licensed APIs. A valid, separately evidenced upstream rights chain would be needed before production use.
stockanalysis.audience: Regular/individual investors are its stated audience. No named Monid endpoint customers verified.
stockanalysis.decision: Hold production integration pending an explanation and proof of lawful programmatic supply.

defillama.name: DefiLlama equities
defillama.coverage: Exact supported company count unverified. Official companies-list returns ticker/country identities to enumerate and match; upstream Twelve Data breadth is not proof of this beta subset.
defillama.coverageShort: Unknown exact count; supported ticker/country directory exists.
defillama.source: All eight paths are documented in the vendor’s official Pro API. Equities market/fundamental data is secondary Twelve Data; filing links can lead to primary SEC documents. Monid resale authority remains unverified.
defillama.timing: Beta snapshot/chart service, not a demonstrated tick stream. Short-window charts may use five-minute bars with daily fallback; on-chain venue mappings are hourly. End-to-end lag unmeasured.
defillama.quality: Clearer documented schemas than the web-style wrappers, but beta stability, per-field coverage and source reconciliation need validation.
defillama.rights: DefiLlama API terms and underlying Twelve Data display/redistribution entitlements apply. No confirmed pass-through customer-display grant through Monid. Direct Pro API pricing is a separate purchase route.
defillama.audience: Potential audience: equity and crypto researchers. No named adopter of these exact beta equities/Monid endpoints verified.
defillama.decision: Best low-cost documented API candidate for a limited fundamentals/chart evaluation, after rights and coverage checks.

secform4.name: SECForm4.com
secform4.coverage: No exact company, issuer-CIK or manager count verified for Monid. SEC filing coverage is not a worldwide 50,000-company universe; owner, security and transaction counts are different.
secform4.coverageShort: Unknown company/CIK count; SEC-derived issuer/owner universe.
secform4.source: Private SEC-data aggregator, not the SEC. Original accession numbers/documents are needed to establish each record’s provenance.
secform4.timing: Five public modules disclose a six-month delay: buys, sales, significant buys, insider options and ratios. Company history can be newer. Monid subscription tier and delivered freshness are unverified.
secform4.quality: Potentially highly auditable with originals, but no tested error rate. Amendments, joint reporting, rounded totals and non-split-adjusted shares need handling.
secform4.rights: Website subscriptions do not establish a redistribution/API licence. No public grant for Monid customer display, history storage or exports was established.
secform4.audience: Investors studying executives and institutions are the intended audience. No named production customer verified for these Monid endpoints.
secform4.decision: Do not promise timely insider alerts until tier/lag/rights are proven; prefer official SEC ingestion as the foundation.
